scoring_justification: All scored quantities (peak stress, end-of-compression stress, crack radius) can be recomputed from the raw CSV columns; the paper provides explicit numeric values under the same conditions for comparison.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for the axial stress and crack growth of the Plastic-DCA SiC simulation.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Section 4.1 (peak tensile stress 9.3e-3 Mbar, point B) and Section 4.2 (axial stress -0.51 Mbar and c/c0≈5.9 at strain -0.2).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the published paper text; these are the model outputs for the specified SiC parameters and loading paths.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results, verifiable by reading the published article.

outputs.description: Time-series data from cyclic uniaxial strain loading simulation. The checker derives the peak axial stress during first tension and confirms negligible plastic strain.

Time-series data from monotonic compressive uniaxial strain loading simulation. The checker extracts axial stress and mean crack radius at strain -0.2 and compares them to hidden paper‑reported values within tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will extract scalar quantities from the submitted CSV files and compare them to paper-reported gold values using relative tolerances. No gold values are disclosed in this contract.

steps.description: Peak axial stress in first tensile loading and absence of plastic strain for SiC cyclic case
Axial stress and crack radius ratio at strain -0.2 for SiC compression case
